rationale: C02 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both proclamations redefine a monument through exterior boundaries encompassing multiple ownership categories, immediately constitute federally owned or controlled land as monument land, and provide that privately owned land within those boundaries becomes part of the monument upon federal acquisition. Their recitals also follow the same distinctive sequence: donated land, additional land needed for protection or administration, privately owned land awaiting acquisition, and a numbered public-interest rationale. C15 and C03 share the contingent-acquisition machinery, but less completely match the child's factual and operative structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas it appears that it would be in the public interest to redefine the boundaries ... (1) to correct ... (2) to add ... the said tract donated to the United States and the said tract of public land, and (3) to include within the boundaries ... the said privately-owned lands ... upon acquisition of title thereto by the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas it appears that it would be in the public interest (1) to enlarge ... by adding thereto the said tract of land donated to the United States ... (2) to extend the boundaries ... to include ... the said tract ... and (3) to provide that the last-mentioned tract ... shall become a part ... upon acquisition of title thereto or control thereof by the United States
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel numbered recital organizing donated or federally held land, boundary extension, and future acquisition of private land.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the lands now owned by the United States within the exterior boundaries of the following-described tracts ... shall constitute the Sitka National Monument
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the lands within the following-described boundaries which are now owned or controlled by the United States shall constitute the Muir Woods National Monument
shared_material.explanation: Closely shared operative formulation using exterior described boundaries and present federal ownership to constitute the monument.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the privately-owned lands within such boundaries shall become parts of the monument upon acquisition of title thereto by the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the above-described tract of land within such boundaries which is now owned by the William Kent Estate Company shall become a part of such monument upon the acquisition of title thereto or control thereof by the United States
shared_material.explanation: Substantially identical contingent-acquisition mechanism for private land included within the proclaimed boundaries.

shared_material.child_excerpt: needed for the administration and protection thereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: to afford better protection to the monument and to promote its administration and development
shared_material.explanation: The added lands are justified by the same adapted protection-and-administration rationale.
